title: 第八章 铁骨豹
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
天未亮，雾很浓。

    镇妖司大门口站着一百个人。

    一百个穿黑衣的人，一百把一样的刀，一百张没有表情的脸。他们站得笔直，像一百根插在地上的钉子。没有说话声，没有咳嗽声，连呼吸的节奏都一模一样。

    孙大人站在最前面。剑在腰上。手按在剑柄上。

    只说了两个字：“出发。”

    车队直接往十万大山而去。又是二天一夜，队伍在山下弃车登山。

    已到了那天的那条山脊。

    孙大人看着侯紫，说：“带路。”

    侯紫走在最前面。手指在袖里轻轻搓了一下。老账房教的，紧张的时候，搓手指，手就不抖。

    他回头扫了一眼。一百个人跟着他走，脚步声只有一个。整齐得像一块黑布，在晨雾里慢慢铺开。

    没有重型弩，没有捕兽夹，没有对付大妖的东西。他们带的，都是杀人的东西。

    侯紫低下头，继续往前走。

    风从林子里吹过来。带着松脂的味道。

    走了三个时辰。到了溪边。

    侯紫忽然停住。

    风变了。

    不是山风，是有东西在动。很沉，贴着地面，速度很快。

    一道灰影从灌木丛里蹿了出来。

    铁骨豹，浑身铁灰色的毛，脊背上长着一排骨刺。牙齿像匕首，眼睛是红的。

    它直扑最前面的三个黑衣卫。

    三个黑衣卫同时举刀，动作分毫不差，刀光连成一片。

    但豹子更快。

    它在空中扭了一下身子，三刀全部落空。

    后排的黑衣卫同时张弩，箭雨射出去。

    豹子已经扑到了另一个人面前，爪子挥下去，黑衣卫的刀断成两截。

    黑衣卫都做出了反应，但侯紫看上总觉得就像是一部机器在咬合。

    侯紫站在原地没动，他在看。

    他看出来了，他们的剑招是标准的，他们的反应也是标准的，但也只是标准。

    铁骨豹甩开两个黑衣卫，转身直扑侯紫。它的速度太快，所有黑衣卫都来不及转身。

    风从溪面灌过来，正好撞在侯紫的脸上。侯紫侧转身，遮了下黑衣人这边的方向。

    抬手在豹子的后腿上，轻轻推了一把。

    就这么一下。

    豹子的身子一歪，扑空了。惨叫一声，摔下了溪沟，溅起一片水花。

    豹子吃痛跑了。

    整个林子突然安静了。

    黑衣卫同时转过头，看着侯紫。一百双眼睛，没有任何表情。
content_en:
It was still dark and the fog was thick.

    A hundred people stood at the gate of the Demon Suppression Department.

    One hundred men in black, one hundred identical knives, one hundred expressionless faces. They stood as straight as a hundred nails driven into the ground. There was no talking, no coughing, even the rhythm of breathing was exactly the same.

    Master Sun stood at the front. The sword is at the waist. His hand rested on the hilt of the sword.

    Only two words were said: "Let's go."

    The convoy headed directly towards Shiwanda Mountain. For another two days and one night, the team abandoned the car at the foot of the mountain and climbed the mountain.

    We have reached the ridge that day.

    Lord Sun looked at Hou Zi and said, "Lead the way."

    Hou Zi walked in the front. He rubbed his fingers lightly in his sleeves. The old accountant taught me that when you are nervous, rub your fingers together to stop your hands from shaking.

    He glanced back. A hundred people followed him, and there was only one sound of footsteps. Neat as a piece of black cloth, slowly spreading out in the morning mist.

    There is no heavy crossbow, no animal trap, nothing to deal with the big monster. What they brought was murderous stuff.

    Hou Zi lowered his head and continued walking forward.

    The wind blew from the woods. With the smell of rosin.

    Walked for three hours. Arrived at the stream.

    Hou Zi suddenly stopped.

    The wind changed.

    It's not the mountain breeze, it's something moving. It's heavy, close to the ground, and very fast.

    A gray shadow jumped out from the bushes.

    The iron-skinned leopard has iron-gray fur all over its body and a row of bone spurs on its back. The teeth are like daggers and the eyes are red.

    It went straight to the three black-clad guards at the front.

    The three black-clothed guards raised their swords at the same time, their movements were precise, and the swords flashed together.

    But the leopard is faster.

    It twisted in the air, and all three swords failed.

    The black-clad guards in the back row opened their crossbows at the same time, and rained arrows out.

    The leopard had already jumped in front of another person, swung its claws down, and the black-clothed guard's knife broke into two pieces.

    The guards in black all reacted, but Hou Zi always felt like a machine was biting.

    Hou Zi stood there without moving, he was watching.

    He could see that their sword moves were standard, and their reactions were also standard, but only standard.

    The Iron Bone Leopard shook off the two black-clothed guards and turned around to attack Hou Zi. Its speed was so fast that all the black-clothed guards had no time to turn around.

    The wind came from the stream and hit Hou Zi's face. Hou Zi turned sideways and covered the direction of the man in black.

    He raised his hand on the leopard's hind legs and gave it a gentle push.

    Just for a moment.

    The leopard tilted its body and missed. With a scream, he fell into the ditch, causing a splash of water.

    The leopard ran away after the pain.

    The whole forest suddenly became quiet.

    The black-clad guards turned their heads at the same time and looked at Hou Zi. One hundred pairs of eyes, expressionless.
